policy_class: Qwen semantic planner + RGB tools + numerical pose skills

model_requests.instruction:
Task: Pick the lemon wedge from the cabinet and place it on the counter.
Identify the movable source object to pick up and return its name in target. Images are ordered left camera, right camera, wrist camera. For each view, describe its appearance and give its visible center. All points must refer to that same source object. If it is not visible, set visible false and point_2d null. Use relative coordinates 0 through 1000 on each image; top-left [0,0], bottom-right [1000,1000].

left.description: The lemon is not visible in the left camera view.

right.description: The lemon is not visible in the right camera view.

wrist.description: The lemon is not visible in the wrist camera view.

model_requests.instruction:
Task: Pick the lemon wedge from the cabinet and place it on the counter.
Source name hint: lemon. Identify ONLY the task source, respecting its object type, shape, and stated source location. The mask must isolate the source itself: exclude its plate, tray, shelf, sink floor and other supports. A mask containing food together with its plate is not a source-only mask. Prefer the tight source-only candidate. Objects already in the destination are not substitutes. A similar color does not establish identity. The source may be outside this view; return visible=false and mask_id=null if none matches. All three images derive from the SAME left camera: original scene, numbered isolated-color masks, then corresponding binary masks. Select the source mask ID and describe its shape and support surface.

response.reason: The task is to pick a lemon wedge from a cabinet shelf and place it on the counter. The lemon wedge is located on a wooden shelf in the background (visible in the right camera). The robot arm is positioned in front of the counter. The 'PickPlaceCounterToDrawer-seed7' skill uses a 'direct' approach with a 90-degree descent. Although the source is a shelf and the target is a counter (inverse of the skill name), the 'direct' approach is suitable for picking an object from an open shelf where there is clear space above. The 'side_horizontal' approach from the other skill is less suitable as the shelf is recessed and a direct vertical approach is more standard for shelf items. The parameters (pregrasp 0.12m, lift 0.15m) are reasonable for a small object like a lemon wedge. The robot will need to re-localize the lemon wedge and plan a path to approach it from above, grasp it, lift it, and move it to the counter.
